user.description: Address of your ring. This can by found a few different ways, but the easiest are visiting (your home assistant URL)/config/bluetooth/advertisement-monitor and finding something with a Name like R02_XXXX, R03_XXXX, R06_XXXX or R08_XXXX OR using Gadgetbridge on Android. The integration connects and verifies the protocol family before the device is added.

error.auth: The ring answered every command with 'not bound'. Another phone or PC may still hold its Bluetooth pairing: remove it from that device's Bluetooth (paired devices) list, power-cycle the ring (charger in, then off your finger), and try again.
error.connection: Unable to reach the ring over Bluetooth. Is it in range, awake, and not held by another device or app?

init.description: Heart rate freshness, BLE polling, history backfill, and gesture detection options.

data.hr_stale_after_polls: Heart Rate goes Unknown after this many missed polls
data.poll_max_interval: Poll the ring this often even if no new data is expected (minutes)
data.backfill_on_reconnect: Recover samples recorded on the ring while out of Bluetooth range
data.gesture_hold_still_s: Hold still gesture: hold still for this many seconds
data.gesture_hold_flip_s: Hand flip gesture: hold still this many seconds before and after flipping hand 180°
data.gesture_hold_raised_s: Raised hand gesture: hold your hand still and raised (Vertical Angle above ~70°) for this many seconds
data.gesture_hold_chop_s: Hand chop gesture: hold raised (above ~70°) and then flat (below ~20°) for this many seconds each, with a rapid drop between
data.motion_stream_timeout: Motion stream timeout minutes, to save battery (0 = unlimited)
data.wave_timeout: Wave detection timeout minutes, to save battery (0 = unlimited)
data.motion_sensor_update_s: Min seconds between accelerometer sensor updates, to save db space. 0 or decimals are allowed
data.vertical_flat_deg: Angle calibration: raw angle that means flat (reported as 0°). Set 0 if a flat hand already reads ~0; raise it (20 max) if it reads high.
data.vertical_upright_deg: Angle calibration: raw angle that means upright (reported as 90°). Set 90 if a fully vertical hand already reads ~90; lower it (70 min) if it reads low.
